decisions.reason: The second V must still derive from the Hero V's shared geometry; the Hero V refinement does not alter that construction relationship or establish a separate second-V value.
The source changes only the Hero V arm relationship and preferred geometry option; it does not change the deferred E and L construction requirements.
The accent's requirement to derive from the Hero V remains valid unchanged; the source does not establish a new accent-specific correspondence or replace any existing attribute.
The client provides design feedback and selects an option but does not change the obligation to include rationale with each design round.
The source concerns black-and-white Hero V geometry and does not change the deferred champagne-metal direction or its application constraint.
Selecting and refining the Hero V arm geometry does not change the deferred wordmark spacing or cohesive-reading goals.
The source contains no decision about preview delivery formats or file accessibility.
